title: Study preflight results
description: One pass/fail result per named gate, and the digests of every document the gates read. The document is ALWAYS complete: every gate appears with its real outcome, including the ones after a failing one, and a gate that could not run appears as 'did not run' with the condition that stopped it. A cold reader must be able to see that the gates ran, not only that the study proceeded — a record section fillable only by hand from stderr is the hand-copying that snapshot rules exist to prevent. This is not a weakening of no-partial-output, which bars torn writes: the document is written once, atomically, complete. The process exits non-zero whenever outcome is 'fail'.

source_digest.description: tool-source-digest/v1 names an algorithm — canonical text over a NAMED file list — not one particular list. files[] is therefore required: without it one recipe id would silently mean different things across the tools that emit it.

inputs.description: Repo-relative paths of what was gated. Never absolute.

input_digests.description: sha256 of each document that was readable. A document that could not be read has no digest and its dependent gates read 'did not run'.

status.description: 'did not run' carries the condition that stopped it in detail, so a reader can tell a gate that refused from a gate that never got the chance.

detail.description: On failure this must LOCATE the fault: the key, the file, the drifting fingerprint, or the recomputed-versus-declared pair.

warnings.description: Advisory only, and only on sibling_scan, which can never fail. A suffix match is a hint about a quantity, not evidence about one, and it is never merged into declared membership.
